Name: Easy Cleaner
Author: gggl634624654567
Description:
Use tool and press key combination(Shift + RightClick) to clean sundries, Use Scythe LeftClick will clean Weeds and Breakable Container. And your Magnetic Radius is very large.
if axe in your inventory, will clean twigs;
if pickaxe in your inventory, will clean stones;

Attention: Will consume a lot of physical energy, do not use when food is insufficient

(In Multiplayer, large Magnetic Radius is only effective when the mod is installed to Server Host)

Mod configs in config.json: (can use [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url])
  "EasyCleanerAssistKey": "LeftShift"; //press this key and RightClick to start cleaning
  "CleanRadius": from -1 to 20 steps;
[s]  "CleanTreeSeedInFarm": true;  //clean tree seeds in your farm when you have axe. (except tree seed fertilized)
  "EnableIndoorsLocation": false;  //allow to clean stones in the Mines or Skull Cavern etc.
  "CleanWitheredCrops": false; //Clean Withered Crops in Farm by Scythe
  "CleanBigTreesOutFarm": false; //Clean BigTrees Out of Farm. (except trees fertilized or tapped, and mushroomTree/mysticTree/palmTree)
  "CleanBigTreesInFarm": false; //Clean BigTrees in Farm. (except trees fertilized or tapped, and mushroomTree/mysticTree/palmTree)[/s]


中文说明：
[spoiler]
[b][size=4]轻松清理[/size][/b]
[size=1][i]花径不曾缘客扫，蓬门今始为君开。——杜甫《客至》[/i][/size]

挥舞镰刀(或武器)时自动清理设定范围内的杂草、绿雨大块杂草、补给箱等杂物；
手持工具，按下“Shift + 鼠标右键”组合键时，一键自动清理范围内散落的树枝、石块等杂物；（需要背包中有对应的斧头、稿子等工具；工具为钢制及以上等级时，还会清理周围的大树桩及大石块）
（此MOD会增大吸附范围以便收集清理后的掉落物，联机模式中只有主机安装此MOD才会对增大吸附范围生效）

注意：清理时可能会消耗大量的体力，食物不足时请谨慎使用；

配置项：（可以使用[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]通用配置菜单[/url]自定义配置）
EasyCleanerAssistKey 一键清理的辅助按键，默认 Left-Shift；
CleanRadius 清理范围设置，设置为-1表示全屏清理
[s]CleanTreeSeedInFarm 设置是否清理农场中散落的树种（需背包中有斧头）；
EnableIndoorsLocation 设置是否允许在室内区域(如矿井、火山中)使用一键清理操作；
CleanWitheredCrops 设置是否清理枯萎的庄稼（需手持镰刀）；
CleanBigTreesOutFarm 设置是否清理农场外的大树（需背包中有斧头）；
CleanBigTreesInFarm 设置是否清理农场内的大树（需背包中有斧头）；[/s]
[/spoiler]
